providers.name: Google Safe Browsing
providers.typicalQuota: Default project quota; operator must verify the current allocation in Google Cloud Console.
providers.rateLimit: Provider-managed project quota; no universal numeric quota is promised.
providers.retentionNotes: Honor the cacheDuration returned by v5. Do not show a warning after the cached match expires.
providers.submissionPrivacy: The lookup sends the redacted URL to Google. Google states that submitted URLs and associated data may be retained, used, and shared.
providers.operatorNotes: Free Safe Browsing access is noncommercial. The adapter uses the v5 URL-search lookup and never submits a URL for a new scan.

providers.name: URLhaus
providers.typicalQuota: Community API fair use; exact limits are not published as a fixed universal quota.
providers.rateLimit: Fair use; data exports must not be fetched more often than documented.
providers.retentionNotes: This project performs individual lookups and keeps only short-lived normalized results in memory.
providers.attribution: Data provided by URLhaus, operated by abuse.ch and Spamhaus.
providers.submissionPrivacy: The lookup sends the redacted URL to URLhaus. New URL submission is not implemented.
providers.operatorNotes: Community access is free under fair-use principles. Commercial or for-profit use may require the enhanced commercial API. URLhaus covers malware-distribution URLs, not every kind of scam.

providers.name: PhishTank
providers.typicalQuota: Dynamic hourly limit returned in X-Request-Limit headers; a valid application key receives a higher limit.
providers.rateLimit: Respect X-Request-Limit-Interval, X-Request-Limit, and X-Request-Count; HTTP 509 indicates over limit.
providers.retentionNotes: Only normalized lookup outcomes are cached briefly. The downloadable database is not redistributed.
providers.attribution: Phishing data provided by PhishTank, operated by Cisco Talos.
providers.submissionPrivacy: The lookup sends the redacted URL to PhishTank. This project does not submit reports.
providers.operatorNotes: Official terms state that API data is available for commercial use without charge. Only verified, currently valid entries affect scoring.

providers.name: LevelBlue Labs Open Threat Exchange (OTX)
providers.typicalQuota: No fixed public quota was found in the official public documentation; operators must monitor response headers and current account terms.
providers.rateLimit: Provider-managed; the adapter treats HTTP 429 as rate limited and does not retry immediately.
providers.retentionNotes: Community pulse summaries are used only for the immediate result and are not redistributed as a feed.
providers.attribution: Community threat intelligence provided by LevelBlue Labs Open Threat Exchange (OTX).
providers.submissionPrivacy: The indicator lookup sends the redacted URL to OTX. OTX terms allow submitted content to be retained, used, and distributed; this project does not use submission endpoints.
providers.operatorNotes: OTX is free to end users for noncommercial use. Pulse counts are community context and cannot produce the maximum score by themselves.

providers.name: VirusTotal
providers.typicalQuota: Public API: 4 requests per minute and 500 requests per day, verified 2026-07-30.
providers.rateLimit: 4 requests per minute and 500 per day for the public API; multiple accounts may not be used to evade limits.
providers.retentionNotes: The public documentation does not grant this project permission to redistribute raw analysis data. Results are not cached by default.
providers.attribution: Aggregated URL analysis provided by VirusTotal.
providers.submissionPrivacy: Existing URL reports are requested by identifier. New URL submission and file upload are disabled.
providers.operatorNotes: The Public API is noncommercial and not for business workflows. This adapter checks an existing URL record only and never submits a URL for analysis.
